newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE UNITED SET FOR DUBLIN TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE UNITED SET FOR DUBLIN TOURNAMENT.

text.p: English premier league club Newcastle United said on Wednesday they would send a side to compete in a quadrangular tournament at Lansdowne Road in July.

"It is very important for us. We start back training on July 7 and this is the ideal place for us to come and prepare for the start of the new season on August 9," Newcastle manager Kenny Dalglish said.

Scottish premier division club Glasgow Celtic and Dutch club PSV Eindhoven will also send sides to the event on July 15 and 16 which will also involve the national league of Ireland premier division champions.
